args.content:
Activity 5: Volunteer Day
  - Description: The team dedicates a day to volunteering at a local charity or community organization. Activities might include organizing a food drive, cleaning up a park, or helping at a shelter.
  - Objective: To build team spirit while giving back to the community and developing empathy and social responsibility.
  - Location: Local community center
  - Date: 2024-01-20
  - Time: 09:00 - 15:00

Activity 6: Escape Room Challenge
  - Description: Teams are placed in themed escape rooms where they must work together to solve puzzles, find clues, and escape within a time limit.
  - Objective: To enhance communication, problem-solving, and collaboration under pressure in a fun and engaging environment.
  - Location: Escape Room Downtown
  - Date: 2024-02-10
  - Time: 14:00 - 16:00
